name: North Okanagan Conservation Fund
summary: Local fund for conservation projects that reduce threats to wetlands, riparian areas, grasslands, forests and wildlife habitat in the North Okanagan, British Columbia; incorporated non-profit societies or their partners apply.

eligibility.rule: Be an incorporated non-profit society in good standing or partner with a registered society
Have the project in a Fund participating area unless otherwise agreed
Address IUCN threats to biodiversity targets and at least one theme area
Not within existing federal, provincial or local government responsibilities
Avoid ineligible activities such as operating-only expenses, lobbying and enforcement
Keep a multi-year project to a maximum of 3 years

applicant_types.quote: Applicants must be an incorporated non-profit society in good standing or must partner with an organization that has registered society status.

pool.quote: The Fund will provide over $80,000 to eligible conservation projects annually.

access.quote: Applicants must be an incorporated non-profit society in good standing or must partner with an organization that has registered society status.
